messages:
Mira - sales: FYI presales swarm for TerraBank POC. They see streaming cutoff after ~14s when connecting from their Windows app through WinHTTP/SSO proxy. Happens in TS + Python SDKs.

Ben - solutions: Do we have a short stack trace and SDK versions?

Mira - sales: TS 1.4.6, Python 1.4.6. Client log: `Error: socket hang up
    at TLSSocket.onConnectEnd (node:_tls_wrap:1429:16)`
Python: `ChunkedEncodingError: ("Connection broken: IncompleteRead(0 bytes read)",)`

Shaan - eng: Pattern aligns with NTLM/WinHTTP reauth or HTTP/2 ALPN issues. On our side the stream for req-id tb-44c is alive and emitting tokens for >2m. So intermediate device likely sending RST or forcing reconnect.

Luca - infra: Confirmed server emitted data. Recommend quick triage: 1) force HTTP/1.1 from client, 2) enable client keepalive pings, 3) check proxy logs for 407/reauth events.

Ben - solutions: Quick commands to ask customer to run:
```
# http2 test (likely to cut)
curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream

# http1 test (workaround)
curl -v --http1.1 --no-keepalive -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
Also `openssl s_client -alpn h2 -connect api.redwood.ai:443` to inspect ALPN.

Mira - sales: TerraBank ran http1.1 curl and stream stayed open for 3+ minutes. They also saw NTLM re-challenge logs coincident with earlier failures.

Shaan - eng: Workaround for TS: set env `REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1=1` or `preferHttp1: true`. For Python set `REDWOOD_HTTP_VERSION=1`. Also set `streamingKeepaliveMs` to 45000 to send periodic pings. Example TS snippet: 
```js
process.env.REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1 = '1';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW, streamingKeepaliveMs: 45000 });
```

Luca - infra: I'll add an internal KB tag so support can quickly find long-lived streams (`x-rw-stream: 1`) and look for server/client mismatch. Opening infra ticket.

Ben - solutions: For security questionnaire: Shaan confirms we use standard TLS 1.2/1.3 and provider-default ciphers; no custom TLS fingerprinting. Provide short FAQ line for them to paste.

Mira - sales: Sending workaround + curl examples and offering a 10-day Dedicated trial so they can test without their corporate proxy.

raven-bot: Note logged: presales/POC-TERRABANK-366789  added KB entry tls-inspect-winhttp-keepalive.

Shaan - eng: If they move to production behind managed proxies, recommend Dedicated/Private deployment or a proxy rule to exempt api.redwood.ai from reauth.

Ben - solutions: Closing swarm for now. Reopen if TerraBank sees perf regressions under HTTP/1.1 workaround. :thumbsup:
